title: PARI class-group Smith transforms
objective: Implement and qualify the square positive full-rank HNF Smith transforms and downstream class-group matrix identities through M1/M2

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary-Python, source-transparent native path from a positive square class-group HNF through PARI's Smith D/U schedule, checked unimodular Ui/V reconstruction, both rounded HNF divisions, and exact M1/M2 assembly. A pristine PARI 2.17.4 UBSan oracle agrees elementwise across 189 CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged cases, while independent matrix identities validate provenance.
risks: PARI/GMP may choose different multiword Bezout coefficients than the documented Sage.js Euclid substitution; multiword nontrivial transforms require identity-based qualification or a source-matched coefficient convention.

The full pnpm test:native correctness suite passed, but its trailing performance suite failed the dense ZZ multiply_150 budget on the shared host (44.13 ms normalized versus 30 ms); no production matrix code changed in this lane.
pnpm test:changed reaches a pre-existing stale optimizer-opportunity manifest on this integration base; this lane does not claim or modify generated shared manifests.
next_steps: Run the checker with --collector-fixtures against freshly generated accepted HNFs and connect the resident owners to the integration driver.
Feed the leading Uir columns into genback while retaining exact relation provenance; then assemble Ga/Ge and the archimedean clg2 fields.
Decide explicitly whether multiword transform-producing Bezout paths require PARI-identical generators or merely independently replayable valid generators.
